verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a sanctioned developer platform (Torch) with keys and a sandbox, but it exposes only two APIs: Case Status and FOIA/PA request creation and status. Most of what the UI does has no API: filing forms (N-400, I-90, I-130, G-28), paying fees, changing address, and the other myUSCIS account functions. The docs state outright that there is no filing API and that myUSCIS is the only online filing rail. Missing for 10: form filing API, fee payment API, address change and account management API, G-28 representation submission API, and any broader claim of API/UI parity.
